summary.detail: Art scholarships (Master in Arts): funding for a first Master's degree at a Swiss art school or conservatory; applicant holds a bachelor's or equivalent and no master's yet. 12 months, extendable to 21 months. Music, visual arts and other artistic domains such as dance, acting or writing; limited list of countries; needs admission letter or proof of application from a Swiss University of the Arts or Music.

PhD scholarships: 12 months, renewable up to 36 months total, any academic field, at a Swiss university or recognised research institute; master's or equivalent required. Research fellowships: one-year (6 to 12 months) research project as part of doctoral studies at a Swiss institution, any discipline, supervisor letter required.
